decision_timing: one fixed 2024-2030 plan chosen before all simulated futures
marginals: inherit Q2-UNCERTAINTY-v1 ranges, trends and discrete levels

dependence.method: Gaussian copula latent factors followed by Q2 marginal mapping
dependence.verification: export realized Pearson and Spearman correlations; targets are assumptions, not estimates

network.restriction: same sales pool and crop class
network.construction: two nearest neighbours by standardized distance, then symmetrize

worlds.RSC: nearest edge substitute, second-nearest edge complement

network.interpretation: synthetic scenario assumptions, not measured market relationships

sampling.holdout_access: forbidden before a later C approval
